title: CandidateRecord
description: One candidate solution, against a frozen ledger version. Single writer: a Generator (Generate), or the Framer for the single B0 candidate. Append-only; a correction is a new record referencing this one.

id.description: Record id: a lower-case type prefix, a hyphen, at least three digits. Unique within a run.

ledger_version.description: The ledger version this record was written against. A CandidateRecord citing a version other than the frozen one is rejected by the Scribe.

references.description: Ids of the records this one is derived from or responds to. Never edit those records; reference them.

technique.description: The brief used. b0 is the Framer's deductive baseline, no technique applied.

mechanism.description: How the candidate works, in relational form where possible.

claimed_gain_vs_b0.description: What this does that B0 does not, stated so the Selector can score it.

premises_introduced.description: Premises this candidate needs that the ledger does not have. Each becomes a PremiseRecord if the candidate is shortlisted.

falsification_test.description: The cheapest test that would show this candidate does not work.

refines.description: Id of the failed CandidateRecord this one is a v2 of, if any. Refinement is a new record, never an edit.
